title: Smooth cutoffs equal to 1 on a compact Lebesgue-null set, with supports of small measure (Simon 6, proof of 2.36, display (2))
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let F ⊆ ℝ^N be compact with L^N(F) = 0 (L^N = volume on Eucl N), and let δ > 0. Then there is a C^∞ function b : ℝ^N → ℝ with compact support such that 0 ≤ b ≤ 1, b = 1 on F, and L^N(tsupport b) ≤ δ, that is, (volume (tsupport b)).toReal ≤ δ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Eucl N)), IsCompact F → (volume : Measure (Eucl N)) F = 0 → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ b : Eucl N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b ∧ HasCompactSupport b ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ b y ∧ b y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y ∈ F, b y = 1) ∧ ((volume : Measure (Eucl N)) (tsupport b)).toReal ≤ δ
